sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Buan is an Irish heroine. She was the wife of the hero Mac Dathó. When he died, his severed head was carried home to her. Buan asked questions of the head. It spoke back to her. The head uncovered the treachery behind his death. Buan wept until she died. A magical hazel called Coll Buana grew from her grave. Cut rods of those hazel bushes served for divination. Buan may descend from the early goddess Búanann.

okr.objective: Describe Buan, the Irish heroine who questioned her husband's severed head.
